caption: A ramp from 0 to 6 with forward first and second differences. f′ is a thick three-cell block; f″ has two thin spikes.

spec.title: A ramp edge and its derivatives
spec.aria: Three rows over seven positions: a ramp from 0 to 6, its forward first difference showing a block of 2s, and its second difference showing a +2 spike at the start and a −2 spike at the end.
